name: Better Auth
tagline: Authentication and authorization for TypeScript applications.
hook: A reproducible error is not automatically a bug: first establish which contract it violates.
summary: Better Auth asks contributors to prove that a reported failure violates a contract before treating it as a bug. The guide checks versions and valid empty results, uses a shared Vitest harness, and keeps library code portable across Node.js, Bun, Deno, and Workers.

techniques.title: Prove the contract violation
techniques.body: Reproduction is the start of triage. The file requires evidence from documented behavior, types, or established runtime semantics before treating the result as a bug.
techniques.quote: A reproducible error is not automatically a bug. First prove the behavior violates Better Auth's documented contract, TypeScript contract, or established runtime semantics.

techniques.title: Separate invalid input from an empty result
techniques.body: The session example distinguishes missing request headers from a real request without a session cookie, showing the API boundary that validation must preserve.
techniques.quote: Distinguish invalid usage from valid empty state. Example: a server session check without request headers is invalid usage; a server session check with headers but no session cookie is a valid request that returns `null`.

techniques.title: Name the portable representation
techniques.body: A specific byte type gives the cross-runtime requirement a practical consequence in everyday code. Tests have an explicit exception.

techniques.title: Bound test execution
techniques.body: The file prohibits the root command because it runs every package, and supplies a file-and-pattern command for focused feedback.
techniques.quote: NEVER run `pnpm test` (runs all packages). Use `vitest path/to/test -t <pattern>`

steal: Require a contract violation before changing reproduced behavior.
Use a paired example to distinguish invalid input from a valid empty state.
Translate platform support into concrete API and type choices.
Give the replacement command whenever prohibiting an expensive default.
